title: IR CloudEvents Envelope
description: Decision R9: every ir.* event uses the CloudEvents envelope in the ir.* namespace with a mandatory `env` attribute. Consumers reject events missing `env` rather than defaulting (FR-IR-TRN-02, patched into the MVP FRD as FR-IRG-TRN-01/02). `data` is validated separately against the per-event-type schema in schemas/events/.

id.description: Unique per event; used for idempotent consumer dedup (FR-IR-LRN-06: dedupe on decision_id + signal_type at the consumer level, this id at the transport level).

source.description: The emitting component's workload identity, e.g. 'urn:ir:dispatch-plane' or 'urn:ir:sidecar:<membrane_id>'.

type.description: Decision R9 naming: ir.routing.requested, ir.routing.bound, ir.routing.tier.tightened, ir.routing.outcome.observed, ir.routing.escalation.triggered (Adaptive-track only, decision R4), ir.guider.hold, ir.attestation.failed, ir.classifier.drift, ir.governance.policy.promoted, ir.partition.entered, ir.partition.cleared, ir.integrity.*, ir.posture.changed.

env.description: Mandatory (decision R9 / FR-IR-TRN-02). MVP emits 'prod' only; 'shadow' and 'sim' are reserved for the Adaptive track (AD-2/AD-5) so isolation is testable before that code exists (Trust Architecture, note on R9).

run_id.description: Required when env=sim (Adaptive FRD FR-IR-TRN-02); absent otherwise.
